source_validation: Require complete full-budget v12f, frozen source and inherited protocols, input/code identity, hashes of every consumed artifact, exact sample IDs/source indices/masks/counts, disjoint regional partitions, saved metrics reconciliation and complete selection replay. Read train_manifest.csv only after its hash matches source provenance. Never load checkpoint weights.
selection_trajectory: Replay all 108 saved epochs with original 16 point constraints and strict global improvement/epoch-0 fallback. Publish failed cohort/region constraints, candidate early worsening, global improvement with early harm, and valid-cell-weighted regional contributions. Selection has per-epoch aggregate metrics only; do not invent per-window or per-week selected selection errors.

audit_groups.incident_full: All originally eligible audit positive forecast windows.
audit_groups.incident_full_common: Restrict the full-positive arrays to IDs in the audit phase's eligible common triples; retain full-positive errors/support rather than subtracting cohort MAEs.
audit_groups.incident_full_complement: Other full-positive audit IDs. This is outside phase-eligible common triples, not necessarily globally unmatched accidents.
audit_groups.incident: Original saved matched positive evaluation, retained separately for replay checks and paired descriptive control contrasts.
audit_groups.primary_control: Original saved primary matched controls, grouped/resampled by paired positive t0 week.
audit_groups.secondary_control: Original saved secondary matched controls, grouped/resampled by paired positive t0 week.

matched_replay: Full/common geometric support and counts must be exact. Compare saved matched positive errors with full-positive common rows using declared batch-replay tolerance, publish maxima and aggregate MAE/gain differences so numerical sensitivity of tiny effects is visible.
bootstrap: Inherit v12c 2000 draws, seed 12028, 95% pointwise intervals, four-week circular-block sensitivity and 95% minimum valid draws. Use the full-positive audit calendar-week grid for every group, including empty subgroup weeks. Keep pooled valid-cell and equal-forecast-window estimands distinct in aggregate and weekly results; publish regional evaluable-window counts. Windows are not unique accident IDs. Empty/sparse regions return explicit insufficient-valid-draw status.
accounting: Common plus complement sums exactly reconstruct full error/count statistics. Publish group/region gain sums divided by full-positive global valid-cell counts, by whole audit and by week; these contributions sum to full global gain. Regional mean gains must not be added without their cell weights. Control target valid counts may differ.
fit_probe: Read the existing initial/last/selected fixed fit subset artifacts and reconcile their saved metrics/IDs. Describe fit-subset gains next to selection and audit. No full-fit evaluation or claim of measured full-fit generalization gap.
interpretation: Post-hoc diagnostic of reused development periods and saved fitted models. Group composition is observational; pooled incident-minus-control gain is descriptive, not causal. Pointwise week/block intervals are conditional on saved weights and omit seed/multiple-comparison uncertainty. Temporal overlap and nine audit calendar weeks limit inference. Candidate harm, noncandidate benefit or fit-probe improvement alone does not identify architecture, information deficiency or overfitting as the cause.
